_meta.purpose: Authoritative IL recreational cannabis tax stack for pre-tax -> out-the-door (OTD) modeling.
_meta.rebuilt_by: Claude (chat) on 2026-06-04, reconstructed from verified sources after Cowork's originals were lost in its sandbox.
_meta.confidence: HIGH for state excise + state ROT + verified local cannabis ROT. MEDIUM for general municipal sales-tax add-ons (verify per store via IDOR MyTax Tax Rate Finder).
sources: IL Dept of Revenue, Cannabis Taxes: https://tax.illinois.gov/research/taxinformation/other/cannabis-taxes.html
86 Ill. Adm. Code 423.105 (concentrates are NOT infused products)

cannabis_purchaser_excise_tax.description: Imposed on the purchaser, by product type and ADJUSTED THC level. Applied to purchase price.

non_infused_thc_le_35.applies_to: Flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, and vapes with adjusted THC <= 35%

non_infused_thc_gt_35.applies_to: Flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, and vapes with adjusted THC > 35%

infused_products.applies_to: Cannabis-infused products only: edibles, tinctures, topicals. Rate is flat regardless of THC.

cannabis_purchaser_excise_tax.CRITICAL_TRAP: Concentrates and vapes are NOT cannabis-infused products. Per 86 Ill. Adm. Code 423.105 they are taxed by adjusted THC (10% or 25%), NOT the 20% infused rate. Do not classify a vape/concentrate as 'infused'.
cannabis_purchaser_excise_tax.adjusted_thc_formula: adjusted_THC% = delta9_THC% + (0.877 * THCa%). Use this against the 35% threshold for non-infused products. Menu-displayed total THC% is usually a close proxy, but where THCa is listed separately, compute it.

state_retailers_occupation_tax.note: Standard 6.25% IL state sales tax (ROT) applies to rec cannabis purchase price.

local_cannabis_retailers_occupation_tax.description: Municipal + county cannabis ROT, specific to cannabis, on top of state. Verified for Peoria-metro jurisdictions.

peoria.source: City of Peoria municipal cannabis ROT

pekin.source: City of Pekin municipal cannabis ROT

canton.confidence: MEDIUM - verify Canton municipal cannabis ROT

peoria_county.note: 3.0% in incorporated municipalities within the county; up to 3.75% in unincorporated areas.

tazewell_county.confidence: MEDIUM - East Peoria/Pekin are in Tazewell Co; verify county cannabis ROT

fulton_county.confidence: MEDIUM - Canton is in Fulton Co; verify

general_local_sales_tax_addon.description: Beyond cannabis-specific ROT, general home-rule/local sales tax may also apply. This is the ESTIMATED layer.
general_local_sales_tax_addon.action_for_code: Pull exact combined general rate per store address from IDOR MyTax Tax Rate Finder; do not hardcode.

worked_examples._note: Effective rates below = sum of (excise + state ROT 6.25% + local cannabis ROT 3% muni + 3% county + ~general add-on). Use to VALIDATE the tax engine.
